svg.title: The hero's sky across 24 hours, one column per ten minutes. Dawn rests at 8:00, day at 12:00, dusk at 18:00, night at 22:00; each sky blends in over the two hours before it, and the blends into dawn and dusk pass through golden hour at 7:00 and 17:00. The sun is up from 7:00 to 18:00, the moon from 19:00 to 6:00. One scroll from day's rest runs 12:00 to 18:00 and blends from 16:00.
